Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Reduced long-encounter hitching with background live-meter calculations, cached results, and background debug-file serialization. Debug capture no longer repeatedly writes accumulated status history. Capture and live widgets are disabled in regular and Deep Dungeons; Variant, Criterion, Criterion Savage, trials, and raids remain supported. Damage formulas and the 250 MiB debug capture limit are unchanged.
